RMjPe7nCW5c-v3h-r7exrw.zh: 美國伊利諾州芝加哥疫情上升,自6/1截至9/30已累計104例病例,已高於2023年(40例)與2024年(53例)同期。病患多為男性,其中有3例住院病例。當局展開疫苗接種活動,呼籲高風險群應接種疫苗。 非洲疫情持續,今年迄9/30已累計26國通報114,784例病例(34,111例確診),其中690例死亡(CFR:0.6%),部分國家疫情上升,包括奈及利亞累計1,312例病例,其中343例確診,4例死亡;肯亞累計532例確診病例,其中8例死亡;馬拉威累計517例病例,其中113例確診,其中1例死亡。另獅子山疫情趨緩,累計5,315例確診病例,其中56例死亡。
RMjPe7nCW5c-v3h-r7exrw.en: Chicago, Illinois, United States: The outbreak is rising. From 1 June to 30 September, a cumulative 104 cases had been reported, already higher than the same period in 2023 (40 cases) and 2024 (53 cases). Most patients are male, and 3 cases have been hospitalized. Authorities have launched vaccination activities and urge high-risk groups to get vaccinated. Africa: Outbreaks continue. As of 30 September this year, 26 countries had reported a cumulative 114,784 cases (34,111 confirmed), including 690 deaths (CFR 0.6%). Outbreaks are rising in some countries. Nigeria has reported 1,312 cumulative cases, including 343 confirmed and 4 deaths; Kenya has 532 confirmed cases, including 8 deaths; and Malawi has 517 cumulative cases, including 113 confirmed and 1 death. Meanwhile, the outbreak in Sierra Leone is easing, with 5,315 confirmed cases cumulatively, including 56 deaths.

8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年迄今已累計25國通報逾95,345例病例(29,493例確診),其中582例死亡(CFR:0.61%),烏干達、幾內亞及迦納疫情上升,烏干達今年截至8/10已累計6,466例確診病例,其中41例死亡;莫三比克自今年7月爆發疫情,截至8/7累計170例疑病例,其中29例確診,迄無死亡案例,該國鄰近馬拉威、南非、尚比亞及辛巴威,跨境風險增加;獅子山疫情更新,該國今年截至8/11累計5,115例確診病例,疫情趨緩。
8a2xXPUtkd7e1z-9VgNgJw.en: Mpox outbreaks continue in Africa. So far this year, 25 countries have reported more than 95,345 cases (29,493 confirmed), of which 582 died (CFR: 0.61%). Outbreaks are rising in Uganda, Guinea and Ghana. Uganda had cumulatively reported 6,466 confirmed cases as of 10 August this year, of which 41 died. Mozambique's outbreak began in July this year; as of 7 August, 170 suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 29 were confirmed, and no deaths have been reported so far. The country borders Malawi, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe, increasing cross-border risk. Sierra Leone's outbreak update: 5,115 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported this year as of 11 August, and the outbreak is easing.

7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山今年截至8/4報告5,072例確診病例,其中47例死亡,多集中於西部城市與農村地區,單週(29週)報告逾200例;迦納今年截至7/31報告302例確診病例,於7/22-30新增45例,另於7/27報告首例死亡案例;幾內亞疫情上升,今年截至7/26報告381例確診病例,其中1例死亡,男性占約7成,新增3區有報告病例。
7qHy8qJpcsJZ3_vaW_-e3w.en: In Africa, Sierra Leone had reported 5,072 confirmed cases as of 4 August this year, of which 47 died. Cases are concentrated in western urban and rural areas, with more than 200 cases in week 29 alone. Ghana reported 302 confirmed cases as of 31 July this year, with 45 new cases between 22 and 30 July, and reported its first death on 27 July. Guinea's outbreak is rising: 381 confirmed cases had been reported as of 26 July this year, including one death; men account for about 70%, and three new districts have reported cases.

axYehbXxXPw7Wm4knSP1bA.zh: 甘比亞宣布爆發疫情,7/22報告首例,病患為26歲女性,來自該國西部第1衛生區,18日確診,感染源及分支不明;鄰近該國之幾內亞於近期爆發疫情,幾內亞今年截至7/25已累計206例病例,新增1例死亡;獅子山疫情更新,今年截至7/13已累計逾4,700例病例,其中35例死亡。
axYehbXxXPw7Wm4knSP1bA.en: The Gambia has announced an outbreak. The first case was reported on 22 July: a 26-year-old woman from the first health region in the western part of the country, diagnosed on 18 July. The source of infection and clade are unknown. Neighboring Guinea has also recently had an outbreak; as of 25 July this year, Guinea has cumulatively reported 206 cases, with 1 new death. Sierra Leone's update: as of 13 July this year, more than 4,700 cumulative cases have been reported, including 35 deaths.

O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山報告自今年初截至6/17累計4,098例確診病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:0.6%),該國已為非洲病例數第三多之國家,僅次剛果民主共和國及烏干達;迦納疫情上升,自今年截至6/18累計117例確診,7成病例分布於該國西部;賴比瑞亞報告今年截至5/31累計69例確診病例,包含IIa及IIb型病例,當局已發布警報,以防止社區及跨境傳播。 美國麻薩諸塞州6/17報告該州首例I型且為該國第5例病例,曾有中非旅遊史,當局研判該國與該州的傳播風險為低。
O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.

mCgEc_7DIupy-97GTrGcyQ.zh: 獅子山疫情嚴峻,今年截至5/24累計3,059例,其中14例死亡(CFR:0.45%),病例遍及全國,該國病例數自4月中旬快速上升,近10日(5/14-24)病例數增加50%,推估於疫情早期階段可能已存在隱性之社區傳播,因目前疫情仍持續上升,顯示現有防疫措施未能有效阻斷傳播鏈。
mCgEc_7DIupy-97GTrGcyQ.en: Sierra Leone's outbreak is severe. This year, as of 24 May, 3,059 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 14 deaths (CFR 0.45%), and cases are found throughout the country. Case numbers have risen rapidly since mid-April, and over the past 10 days (14–24 May) cases increased by 50%. It is estimated that covert community transmission may already have existed in the early stage of the outbreak. Because the outbreak is still rising, existing prevention and control measures have not been effective in blocking chains of transmission.

AHuvs5bXiYozu6bjRUg94w.zh: 獅子山疫情持續上升,自5/9-16單週新增611例病例,高於前1週483例,為IIb型病例,男性占68%,病例集中於西部區等6個區域,亦包含首都自由城。自今年1月截至5/18累計報告2,045例確診,其中11例死亡(CFR:0.54%)。另,剛果民主共和國、烏干達及蒲隆地上週病例略有增加,整體呈下降趨勢。當局持續進行疫苗接種活動。 多哥於5/16報告該國首例,病患為22歲女性,居住於該國首都洛梅,5/11出現發燒及皮疹症狀就醫,近15日內無旅遊史,經檢驗為IIb型,另該病患丈夫亦確診,兩人皆隔離接受治療。
AHuvs5bXiYozu6bjRUg94w.en: Sierra Leone's outbreak continues to rise: from 9 to 16 May, 611 new cases were reported in one week, up from 483 the previous week. These are clade IIb cases, 68% of them male, and cases are concentrated in 6 areas including the Western Area and the capital, Freetown. Since January this year, 2,045 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively as of 18 May, including 11 deaths (CFR 0.54%). Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and Burundi increased slightly last week, but the overall trend is declining. Authorities continue vaccination campaigns. Togo reported its first case on 16 May: a 22-year-old woman living in the capital Lomé, who developed fever and rash on 11 May and sought medical care. She had no travel history in the past 15 days. Testing identified clade IIb, and her husband also tested positive; both are isolated and receiving treatment.

Nfo_A9LwasAwfLVfxp5WLA.zh: 巴西亞馬遜州疫情上升,今年截至4月累計33例病例,多為男性,年齡介於30-39歲,當局將持續採取預防措施,另該州2023年全年僅累計10例病例。其鄰近帕拉州今年截至4/28累計19例病例、其中2例死亡。 獅子山疫情持續,截至5/8累計1,603例確診病例,其中11例死亡,病例多為IIb型男性、年齡介於30-35歲,分布於該國西部,包含首都自由城。另非洲部分高負擔國家,如剛果民主共和國等疫情已趨緩。 英國5/8報告,自2024年10月截至2025年4月30日累計12例Ib型病例,多數病例與疫區旅遊有直接或間接相關。另自2023年截至2025年4月30日累計508例IIb型病例,病例多為MSM族群。
Nfo_A9LwasAwfLVfxp5WLA.en: Brazil's Amazonas State outbreak is rising: as of April this year, 33 cases have been reported cumulatively, mostly in men aged 30–39. Authorities will continue preventive measures. The state reported only 10 cases for the whole of 2023. Neighboring Pará State reported 19 cases as of 28 April this year, including 2 deaths. Sierra Leone's outbreak continues: as of 8 May, 1,603 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 11 deaths. Most cases are clade IIb men aged 30–35, distributed in the west of the country, including the capital Freetown. Outbreaks in some high-burden African countries, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, have slowed. The UK reported on 8 May that from October 2024 to 30 April 2025, 12 clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively, most of which were directly or indirectly linked to travel to affected areas. In addition, from 2023 to 30 April 2025, 508 clade IIb cases were reported cumulatively, mostly among men who have sex with men (MSM).

It2fJ-zJy5tslV7knC8yoA.zh: 獅子山今年1月宣布公共衛生緊急狀態,今年迄今報告763例,其中6例死亡,病例數以首都自由市為多,WHO提供該國6萬餘劑疫苗,自4月起為醫護人員、高風險族群及12歲以上孩童進行接種。
It2fJ-zJy5tslV7knC8yoA.en: Sierra Leone declared a public health emergency in January this year. So far this year, 763 cases have been reported, including 6 deaths, with cases concentrated in the capital, Freetown. WHO has provided more than 60,000 vaccine doses, and since April vaccination has been given to health workers, high-risk groups and children aged 12 and over.

O9V5bJqjBQyD5YQfJN6Elg.zh: 烏干達近期疫情上升且嚴峻,自今年迄今已有3例輸出病例至英國,皆為Ib型,依據WHO統計自2024/7/29截至2025/1/17已有2,031例確診病例,其中10例死亡(CFR:0.4%),疫情主要在坎帕拉。 獅子山於今年1/11報告該國首例確診,為IIb分支型病例。截自1/26累計7省16例確診。病患中有10例為男性,年齡範圍為1-52歲,其中1例為醫護人員,當局已匡列293位接觸者。
O9V5bJqjBQyD5YQfJN6Elg.en: Uganda: The outbreak has risen and is severe. Since the start of this year, three exported cases, all clade Ib, have been reported to the United Kingdom. According to WHO, from 29 July 2024 to 17 January 2025, 2,031 confirmed cases were reported, including 10 deaths (CFR 0.4%); the outbreak is mainly in Kampala. Sierra Leone: On 11 January this year, the country reported its first confirmed case, a clade IIb case. As of 26 January, 16 confirmed cases had been reported in seven provinces. Ten of the patients are male, aged 1–52 years, and one is a healthcare worker. Authorities have listed 293 contacts.
